# Autovex Solutions

> Services agency building business-process automation first, plus web platforms
> and mobile apps. Small senior team led by Ishaq; fixed-scope engagements shipped
> in weeks, with the expected return stated up front.

## What we do

- Automation (core service): wiring CRM, inbox, sheets and invoicing into
  pipelines that run end to end — n8n + OpenAI, deterministic where it matters.
- Web: fast, search-friendly marketing sites and web apps (Next.js).
- Mobile: iOS and Android from one codebase (React Native).

## How engagements work

Map (audit of where hours go) → Blueprint (fixed scope, expected return, typical
$3–10k over 3–6 weeks) → Build (working demo every Friday) → Run (monitor and improve).

## Free teardown

Email one workflow you hate to hello@autovex.solutions and get back a teardown
within 48 hours: where the hours go, what we'd automate, what it saves per month.
